abilities.effect: The haunt deals 4d8 slashing damage with semisolid claws (DC 18 basic Will save). On a failed save, the target is also frightened 1 and fleeing for 1 round (or frightened 2 and fleeing for 1 minute on a critical failure).
abilities.name: Tiger Slash
abilities.trigger: A living creature approaches within 5 feet of the cave painting

hazard.description: A cave painting of a great cat roars to life and leaps off the wall to attack.
hazard.disable: DC 18 Nature (trained) or Religion (trained) to quell the spirit
hazard.name: Pouncing Tiger Haunt
hazard.reset: If the cave painting isn't destroyed, the haunt resets after 1 day

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
